sentences.en: Copernicus studied medical astrology while at the University of Padua.
sentences.zh: 科普特尼库斯在帕多瓦大学学习医学占星学。

sentences.en: At the time, astronomy was still intrinsically linked to astrology.
sentences.zh: 当时，天文学仍然与占星术密不可分。

sentences.en: I'm a Pisces, which means I believe in astrology.
sentences.zh: 我是双鱼座，所以相信占星学。

senses.zh: 占星术, 占星学(以观测天象来预卜人间事务的一种方术)。
